integrity: The proposition statement, stated positivity assumptions, final Castillo–Chavez remainder argument, and calibrated recruitment rates were checked directly in the public full text; the decisive numerical inequality is reproduced exactly.
scientific_limitations: The finding establishes a gap in the displayed proof's coverage, not a counterexample to the global-stability theorem.
An alternative proof could remove the auxiliary recruitment-order comparison.

The accepted conclusion relies only on the explicit recruitment-rate inequality and the source's calibrated table; it does not require deciding whether the separate comparison between susceptible mosquitoes and total humans can be justified on a smaller invariant set.
title: The published Chikungunya global-stability proof does not cover its calibrated recruitment rates
